summary:

Controls distinguish suspension and norm omission. Conditional support only; all applicability, positive endorsement, contrary-sign exceptionlessness and actual-contingent cognition premises remain OPEN. Beneficial deception survives as a positive rival; structural permission model does not prove its metaphysical possibility. Rejected factivity, non-discursiveness-only, capacity-to-actuality and church-authority circularity shortcuts. Next tests: act-object versus welfare norm under fixed truthful alternatives; actual-contingent access and propositional assent bridge. Semantic challenge repair: inherited Prop-indexed attitudes identify logically equivalent contents; these are extensional truth-value-level results, with transfer to individuated cognitive/assertoric contents OPEN. Computed supported-to-closed classification of 7cffee54 does not supply independent warrant or fully grounded establishment. Individuated-content continuation (separate proposed checkpoint): reuses ReflectiveCoherence.Semantics and Disquotes; content-identity A/B routes, explicit domain/negation closure, and one-way representation connect to legacy assertion truth. Tagged co-true-at-every-world selective model witnesses no exact Prop-assent translation; existential erasure is intentionally lossy. Restored cognitive rival and two domain-gap controls preserve the moral/actual-access burdens. Exact framework and proposed assessment in the same linked note; no new historical attribution or psychological mechanism claim. Act-object continuation: selected ST I q19a9 and Descartes MedIV readings preserved in same note. Reused the exact OptimalCreationChoice result linked in evidence instead of duplicating a tied-choice toy certificate. An equally beneficial truthful alternative does not alone imply strict moral dominance under a policy permitting all maximizing acts; application of the order result to moral permission is an explicit analyst assumption, not an existing ethical theorem. Assertoric responsibility and rational agency give reasons against contrary assertion, but actual-assent and exceptionless-priority steps remain disputed. Strongest welfare/agency rival owes a complete good comparison and an override justification; no existing evidence establishes universal truthful-alternative dominance or defeats it. Next test: defended non-overridable responsibility priority or specified overriding countercase holding genuine assertion, speaker, content and alternatives fixed. No computed premise change. Cognitive-defect continuation in same note: inspected SCG61 and supporting actual-operation/pure-act/self-cognition reasoning, ST q85a6 and q17aa2–3 qualifications, exact IsPerfect/IsSupremelyGood bodies, and full #1380/FormSelection evidence. Proper-object/self-access and truth aim do not establish all asserted contingent judgments; ignorance is not false assent. Full actual intellectual perfection remains a stronger positive account, not refuted by finite fallible subjects or structural reference proxies. Root A needs only accuracy at identical actual asserted-and-assented contents, but choosing that scope does not warrant its cognitive success. No duplicate predicates/proofs/models; operation-identity and due-cognitive-privation applicability to same GOD_4 plus actual contingent reference remain exact gaps. Next material dependency is actual operation/perfection rather than power, or an independently warranted inerrant domain with assertion coverage. No premise change. Operation-identity continuation in same note: selected q14aa2/4/ad15, q25a1, q79aa1–2, q54a1 and q18a3 distinguish immanent cognitive perfection from unused active power, and concomitance from real identity. Blanket active/passive equivocation objection misses the source own distinction. Reused actual pureActOperatesFromBeing theorem and omission controls; exact same-GOD4 full25 witness retains no typed actual cognitive operation/identity. Esse/essence Principle equality does not identify a separate O operation. Extrinsic mismatch architecture and strongest causal/exemplar reply remain live with intentional adequacy obligations; frozen unindexed assent does not preserve source time/content treatment. No new map/flag/proof; next test calibrates immanent cognitive form/operation and passive subject-act potentiality, then one actual asserted contingent content with separate selection/reference/efficacy. No premise change. Recipient-directed historical-inquiry continuation, 2026-11-24, at docs/notes/divine-veracity-1410.md#recipient-directed-nondeception-and-historical-inquiry-2026-11-24. Distinguishes an actual end of true historical understanding from mere useful prediction. Such an end supplies a defeasible reason against systematic false-history policy when knowledge, a genuinely superior feasible truthful policy or a defended recipient-protection prohibition, effective choice and actual channel scope are supported. Reuses the existing tied-optimum boundary: equal benefit does not exclude false inducement without strict full-order dominance or an additional norm. Restores ordinary local error/correction, fiction, secondary agency and independently identified proper conditions; a fallible inquiry end is not a promise that every record is true. SourceEvidenceAdequacy supplies a conditional individuated-content assembly plus populated production/transport omissions and a matching nonmental copying control, all without deriving source veracity itself. Comparative advantage over a comparably warranted necessary impersonal mechanism remains underdetermined; direct, primitive and cumulative warrant are retained. No source attribution or computed root premise change.

Recipient-undertaking continuation (#1958, 2026-11-24), scoped to docs/notes/divine-veracity-1410.md#recipient-undertakings-and-truthful-selective-records-1958-2026-11-24: distinguishes assertion of historical content, stewardship of a specified inquiry, and enabling corrigible inquiry. A fixed-source, fixed-recipient selective-disclosure case adds the positive-record-truth versus completeness boundary: all supplied entries can be true while an actually adopted absence inference is false. One recipient policy responds differently to unqualified, limited and provisional information; no changed reasoner is substituted. Genuine implicit assertion of completeness falls under the existing ContentAssertionTruth target; otherwise the broader responsibility for invited reliance is an explicit normative application. Faithful disclosure strictly improves the covered inquiry only when feasible and preserving the full set of other goods; candid limitation can protect reliance under confidentiality without providing every historical answer. Limited genuine stewardship is the strongest surviving rival to a universal guarantee. A reproducible local core-Lean diagnostic in the note checks the finite inference and completeness restoration; it is not a registered Comparator result. PR-1933 is external checkpoint evidence only. No unconditional historical reliability, worldview ranking, religious historical evidence assessment or computed premise change follows; the original succeeded outcome retains its earlier formal-reconstruction scope.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (a) InitialHistoryAuthenticity.authenticity and controls (84562a64, 027d38f9) separate fiber inclusion in the content truth set, equal readouts, and false-but-uniform fibers. The fixed deterministic law may erase or read a relevant initial coordinate. SourceEvidenceAdequacy.sourceGuarantee (841e7fc2, argument 80237c82, statement 389db8f3) requires the same classified source's individuated assertion truth across admitted histories, assertoric plans, actual realization, same-source token provenance and truth transport. It obtains positive decoded record truth by unpacking the witnessed token and rewriting its received code. copyGuarantee (24906f55) requires target copying, provenance, target range and exact recovery and needs no mental predicate. ContentAssertionTruth (98f13d52) and the legacy representation result (693522aa) retain their actual asserted-content and representation scopes. The channel results do not supply the confirmation bridge c1deb2ee.

(c) The #1958 one-history rule and the fixed-recipient false absence example already compile as SelectiveDisclosure.absence_of_complete and selectiveTruthControl, without a prior result record. The additional two-history application now uses DisclosureIdentification.boundary (1d3e07b1, argument 49202ada, statement 05719a6e-f043-4f6c-8591-f038779062ce). Existing record soundness definition dd7b91ea fixes the positive-truth reading. Under positive soundness, exact correctness of the nonmembership rule is equivalent to completeness across the supplied profile. The same later-only policy admits two histories with true entries and the same list, while the same earlier event varies. Science.Identifiability.proposition_criterion_iff therefore rules out every list-only classifier for that target; complete readouts restore identification in this pair. This is linked by tests to 389db8f3 and 995550a6. It differs from the initial-history false-positive fiber because the disclosed positives are true in both histories.

(e) Fix an actual interval, event class, recipient's rule and reporting process. Test whether a complete record is independently warranted, whether completeness itself is genuinely asserted, or whether the undertaking licenses reliance without that assertion. Candid limitations and a functioning correction channel remain separate policy options. Neither uniform source truth, exact copying of selected tokens nor a finite impossibility proves actual recipient uptake or a norm of comprehensive disclosure. Equal good under the chosen order, on its own, does not exclude a withholding policy (OptimalCreationChoice.checks, a1990e04); an actual strict advantage in all protected goods or a defended duty would change the policy assessment. No probability, historical evidence evaluation, or new source attribution is used.

current_assessment.scope: Issue #1958: recipient-directed application of individuated veracity beyond literal assertion, tested on selective true disclosure and absence inference. Earlier assertion-premise, cognitive and divine-applicability assessments retain their scopes.
current_assessment.assessment: Protecting a specified inquiry gives a substantive reason against knowingly defeating the reasonable reliance the source has solicited. The selected case shows why positive record truth, even with exact transport, does not establish completeness for a negative historical conclusion. If completeness is genuinely asserted, its falsity already falls under ContentAssertionTruth; otherwise a wider responsibility norm must be defended rather than hidden inside Asserts. With the same source, recipient response policy, historical facts and abilities, faithful disclosure defeats concealed selection when it preserves all other relevant goods; under legitimate confidentiality, candid limitation may protect inquiry without answering the historical question. Scoped corrigible stewardship therefore survives as a positive alternative to a universal guarantee. Full-order ties and genuinely competing goods retain the need for priority or a specific constraint; unknown reasons alone do not justify manipulation. Direct, primitive and cumulative warrant remains eligible for equally reliable mental and nonmental accounts, without an assumed prior or ranking. No actual historical channel is supplied or certified, and no root premise is discharged.
current_assessment.next_test: For one particular absence inference, fix the event class, interval and actual recipient policy; identify independently warranted reporting coverage or actual retention coverage, then determine whether it licenses completeness, only partial positive information, or suspension. For a wider prohibition, test one specific claimed reason defeating candid limitation while holding the same recipient and complete feasible policies fixed. Reopen on warranted coverage or priority, or a countercase preserving the full protected undertaking, rather than another abstract channel map.
